subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: FastAIApps
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <claire@fastaiapps.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fastaiapps.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + dedicated capacity options

Thanks for the call today, Rafael  great overview. A few follow-ups from our side to help you size Dedicated: 

- Target TPS: we're seeing ~120 r/s for our 'query' endpoint during peak, but those include short prompts (<= 64 tokens) and very short completions (~50 tokens).
- Modalities: primarily text generation right now (fine-tuned open models), but we may add a reranking/embedding path later.
- SLA expectations: 99.9% monthly uptime, sub-200ms p50 for short prompts, p95 under 1s ideally.

Two asks: can you confirm recommended GPU type (A100 vs H100) for this profile, and an initial node/concurrency suggestion? Also attached is a sample token mix export.

Best,
Claire
Product Lead, FastAIApps

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@fastaiapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: FastAIApps

Hi Claire  thanks for the notes and the token mix CSV, that helps. Looping in Marissa (dedicated ops) and Monica (solutions) to provide a quick sizing recommendation.

High-level notes from our side:
- GPU choice: H100 typically gives best p95 latency for heavy transformer workloads and is our recommendation if you prioritize latency and future headroom; A100 is still cost-effective for throughput-first workloads and when using aggressive quantization.
- From the TPS you reported (~120 r/s), we need to confirm average sequence lengths (prompt vs completion) and concurrency targets to estimate batching efficiency and per-token cost.
- For 99.9% uptime and your latency targets, we usually recommend a baseline pool with 2 warm nodes + 1 surge node (auto-burst) as a starting point.

Marissa / Monica  can you review Claire's token mix and propose a 90-day baseline (nodes, GPU type, expected effective TPS, and concurrency) plus an options table (A100 vs H100 cost/latency trade-offs)?

Next steps: 1) sizing doc from Marissa, 2) we (Redwood) provide an indicative pricing sheet, 3) agreement on rollout plan + timeline.

 Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Claire Zhang <claire@fastaiapps.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: FastAIApps

Thanks Rafael & Claire  dug into the CSV you attached (fastaiapps-token-mix.csv). Summary below plus a conservative sizing estimate.

Token profile (observed):
- Average prompt: 40 tokens
- Average completion: 55 tokens
- Ratio prompt:completion ~ 60:40
- Percent of requests that are short (<64 tokens total): ~72%

Workload characteristics to confirm:
- Model family (open Llama2-like, quantized to 4-bit)  is that correct?
- Any heavy long-runchair sessions (>1k tokens) we should expect intermittently?

Sizing (conservative baseline for production, 99.9% uptime target):
- GPU type: H100 recommended for p95 latency headroom. A100 is acceptable if cost must be constrained; see trade-offs below.
- Nodes: 3x H100 (2 baseline, 1 reserved for burst/maintenance)  this supports ~200 effective r/s for short requests with 8-12 concurrency per model instance depending on batching window.
- Concurrency: recommend starting with target concurrency 10 per instance; adjust after 2-week perf testing.
- Batch sizing: Redwood runtime will adapt batching; expect effective tokens/sec improvements ~1.4x over naive single-request serving for this token mix.

A100 vs H100 trade-offs:
- H100: ~20-35% better p95 for autoregressive workloads, higher $/hr. Recommended if p95 SLA is a blocker.
- A100: lower cost, slightly higher p95; good if you accept p95 in 700–900ms range for short prompts.

Attachments: uploaded the sizing template (redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx) with the node-level cost calc and expected throughput.

Questions for Claire:
1) Can you confirm model quantization level (8-bit vs 4-bit) and whether you require KV cache persistence across requests?
2) Do you have an internal concurrency cap per user/session we should be aware of?

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min perf-run next week to run a 1-hour load test and tune autoscaling thresholds.

Thanks,
Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Dedicated

From: Claire Zhang <claire@fastaiapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fastaiapps.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: FastAIApps

Marissa  this is great, thanks. Quick answers: 
- Model: Llama2-13B derivative, currently quantized to 4-bit; planning to keep 4-bit for production.
- KV cache: we rely on short-session cache per user (not persisted across long idle periods).
- No expected long >1k token sessions in the near term.
- Concurrency cap per user: we throttle at 4 concurrent requests per session.

Please go ahead with the 3x H100 baseline estimate and share the perf-run times you have available next week (we prefer morning PST). Procurement (procurement@fastaiapps.com) is cc'd for budget planning.

Best  Claire

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@fastaiapps.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@fastaiapps.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: FastAIApps

Thanks Claire  noted on 4-bit quant and KV cache pattern. We'll proceed with the 3x H100 baseline and book a 1-hour perf-run slot Monday 2027-03-15 09:00–10:00 PST unless you prefer a different time.

Action items:
- Marissa: deliver updated sizing workbook + indicative pricing (attached).
- Rafael: follow up on procurement questions and draft mutual action plan (MAP).
- Claire / FastAIApps: confirm the perf-run slot and provide any sample prompts you want included.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (updated), indicative-pricing.pdf (stub reference).

 Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Dedicated
